findings.reason: a control that cannot be applied to the implementation measures nothing, so even after the section is retargeted the node could not show its guard fires as written.
findings.text: §23's negative control is "dropping `images` from `_node_from_pointer` makes the case fail", but the rebuild names no field individually: it iterates the dataclass field list, so `images` cannot be dropped from it, and the case §23 asks for already passes at the reviewed revision without any change
